pied.devise: “To know Christ and to make Him known”
pied.appartenance: University Bible Group of Morocco — a member of IFES, Middle East and North Africa region.

commun.themeTitre: Theme of the year · still being written
commun.themeTexte: The theme carrying the ten-year vision for 2023–2033 will be announced here as soon as the National Secretariat has settled it.
commun.envoiReussiTexte: Your city's committee has received it. Someone will reply — and if nobody does within a week, write again: it means something failed, not that you are being ignored.
commun.envoiRefuseChamps: Something is missing. Check your name, how to reach you, and your message.
commun.envoiRefuseIndisponible: The message did not go through: the site cannot reach its database. We would rather tell you than leave you waiting for a reply that would never come. Please try again later.
commun.notificationTitre: Alert to the city committee · not connected
commun.notificationTexte: The message is stored and will appear in the administration space. Automatically alerting the city committee is still to be connected: it needs a sending address that the movement has not yet provided.

accueil.display: Students, one Word, all of Morocco.
accueil.accroche: The University Bible Group brings together students who want to live out and deepen their Christian faith during their years of study. On campus, every week.
accueil.photoTexte: GBUM students on Moroccan campuses, with written permission to publish. They fade from one to the next — no sliding, no zoom. No stock images.
accueil.pratique1Texte: Every week, in a cell group, following the year's study outline.
accueil.pratique2Texte: For one another, for the campuses, for the country.
accueil.pratique3Texte: Arriving alone in a country you don't know is hard. The group is often the first family.
accueil.pratique4Texte: Camps, conventions and national meetings bring together students from every city.
accueil.chiffresTexte: The space is drawn at its final size. The day the National Secretariat gives these figures, they land in a shape already made for them. No placeholder number is shown in the meantime.
accueil.vieTexte: Reports and memories entered by cities and cell groups appear here, without anyone having to retype them.
accueil.vieDerniere: The most recent published activity opens here.
accueil.viePublicationTexte: This band will fill itself the moment a city enters its first activity — that is the point of a site that stays alive without being fed by hand.
accueil.voixCitation: A GBUM student's testimony will go here, with their first name, their city and their year of study.
accueil.voixTexte: Two or three sentences, with written permission to publish. What this audience is looking for is authenticity — not layout.
accueil.tempsFortTexte: A retreat in the Middle Atlas, with students from across the country. Fellowship, rest, and lives that change.
accueil.rejoindreTitre: There may be a group right next to you.
accueil.rejoindreTexte: Choose your city: we put you in touch with its committee, which will tell you the day, the time and the place.

leMouvement.eyebrow: A member of IFES · MENA region
leMouvement.accroche: The GBUM brings together students who want to live out and deepen their Christian faith during their years of study, in Morocco's university cities. A member is called a GBUssien.
leMouvement.devise: “To know Christ and to make Him known”
leMouvement.visionNom: Scouts of the campuses for Christ
leMouvement.visionTexte: Born while preparing the 2023 Ifrane camp, this vision carries the movement for ten years.
leMouvement.visionAnnee: Year 3 of 10. The ten segments are the one thing we can count with certainty: the vision runs from 2023 to 2033.
leMouvement.histoireTexte: Where the movement comes from, and how it got here.
leMouvement.frise1947: IFES is founded at Harvard University by representatives of ten national movements. Headquarters in Oxford.
leMouvement.frise1968: The GBUAF — French-speaking Africa's University Bible Groups — is born at a gathering of some fifteen students in Abidjan. Most GBUssiens in Morocco come from that region.
leMouvement.friseManquantTitre: The founding of the GBUM · date unknown
leMouvement.friseManquantTexte: Between the birth of the GBUAF and the Ifrane camp lies the founding of the movement in Morocco, its milestones, and the people who carried it. None of it is published online: it is for the movement to tell us. This place is kept for it, at its date.
leMouvement.frise2023: Ifrane Camp: the movement gives itself a ten-year vision, running to 2033.
leMouvement.organisationTitre: Five levels, from national to cell group.
leMouvement.niveau1Texte: The National Secretary and their assistants, who oversee the movement in Morocco.
leMouvement.niveau2Texte: Renewed every year. Each member carries a national responsibility; some accompany a city.
leMouvement.niveau3Texte: One committee per city, renewed every year.
leMouvement.niveau4Texte: In neighbourhoods or on campus. This is where the Bible studies take place. Their leaders are renewed every year.
leMouvement.niveau5Texte: Former GBUssiens who support the movement — financially, in prayer, and in other ways.
leMouvement.renvoiTexte: The university cities where the GBUM is present, and how to reach each city's committee.

ouNousSommes.accroche: The GBUM is present in Morocco's university cities. Choose yours: the city committee will put you in touch with the nearest cell group.
ouNousSommes.listeTexte: The cities where the movement is present, in the order it wants them named, and how many cell groups each has. The National Secretariat will enter them from the administration space.
ouNousSommes.pannneTexte: The list of cities could not be read. It does not mean the movement is absent from your city: it means the site cannot reach its database. Write to us and someone will reply.
ouNousSommes.nonPublieTitre: What is not published, and why
ouNousSommes.nonPublieTexte: Not the day, not the time, not the place, not the name of a cell group's leader. Publication stops at the city: the committee will tell you the rest. What does not exist cannot leak.
ouNousSommes.contactTexte: The city leader answers enquiries and points you to the cell group nearest your campus.
ouNousSommes.mandatEchuTexte: City committees are renewed every year. This one has not sent its contact details yet — and we do not display last year's. Write to us in the meantime.
ouNousSommes.aucuneVilleTexte: The “Join” path treats that case with the same care as any other: the nearest city, the Ifrane camp, and the possibility of starting a cell group.

laVieDuMouvement.accroche: Camps, seminars, outings, testimony days. Every report written by a city or a cell group in the working space appears here — nobody retypes it.
laVieDuMouvement.uneTitre: Title of the most recent report
laVieDuMouvement.uneTexte: The opening lines of the report appear here, followed by the city or the national scale, and the date.
laVieDuMouvement.attenteTexte: This page will fill itself the moment the first report is entered in the working space — that is the site staying alive without being fed by hand.
laVieDuMouvement.tempsFort1Texte: The whole movement's annual gathering, in the Middle Atlas.
laVieDuMouvement.tempsFort2Texte: A national activity lived out in the cities and the cell groups, with no gathering in person.
laVieDuMouvement.tempsFort3Texte: With the leaders' and witnesses' camps, and the masterclasses — the movement's training sessions.
laVieDuMouvement.bilansTexte: Newest first. Each entry carries its scale — national, city or cell group — and its date.
laVieDuMouvement.bilanResume: The first two lines of the text entered in the working space.
laVieDuMouvement.souvenirsTitre: Part of our memory is not yet written down.
laVieDuMouvement.souvenirsTexte: The photographs and stories of past years exist — on phones, in chat groups, on hard drives. They are nowhere together. This page is made to receive them.
laVieDuMouvement.voirCanevasTitre: The study outline and its archive
laVieDuMouvement.voirAgendaTexte: What lies ahead, nationally and in the cities.

agenda.accroche: The gatherings open to everyone — camps, conventions, national meetings. City and cell group activities are not published here: the city committee shares those.
agenda.prochainTexte: The students' national retreat, in the Middle Atlas. The whole movement meets there.
agenda.autresTexte: These are real national activities. Only their dates are missing — and they are not guessed.
agenda.evt1Texte: Training for those who lead the cell groups and the city committees.
agenda.evt2Texte: For those who carry the witness on their campus.
agenda.evt3Texte: The national gathering, with the masterclasses — the movement's training sessions.
agenda.evt4Texte: In the cities and the cell groups, with no gathering in person.
agenda.attenteTexte: The dates and practical details of each gathering will be published by the National Secretariat from the administration space.
agenda.calendrierTexte: The calendar can be added to your own: dates update themselves there as soon as the movement publishes them.

leCanevas.accroche: Each year the movement publishes an outline: the sequence of Bible studies that every cell group follows. Past outlines remain open to all.
leCanevas.anneeTitre: This year's outline will appear here.
leCanevas.anneeAttenteTexte: Its title, its introduction, the list of its studies and the file to download will be uploaded by the National Secretariat from the administration space.
leCanevas.archivesTexte: The memory of the movement's studies, open to everyone. The archive is public: that was decided on 9 September 2026.
leCanevas.archivesAttenteTexte: Past years' outlines will be added as they are recovered. Each keeps its year and its number of studies.
leCanevas.ensembleTitre: The outline is meant to be lived together.
leCanevas.ensembleTexte: It is written to be opened in a cell group, out loud, with people. Find the one nearest you.

soutenir.accroche: The GBUM lives on the support of those who believe in what is at stake on campus. There are three ways to help, and they are not equal: the first costs nothing and counts most.
soutenir.prierEyebrow: The first, and the most asked for
soutenir.prierTexte: The movement's prayer letter says, every time, what is really at stake: a city starting again, a camp being prepared, a student arriving alone. It takes three minutes to read.
soutenir.donnerTexte: Gifts pay for camps, for the travel of students who cannot afford it, and for training leaders. A camp costs money, and a camp is often where everything turns for someone.
soutenir.donPonctuelTexte: Once, for whatever amount you choose.
soutenir.donRegulierTexte: Every month. That is what makes planning possible.
soutenir.donAttenteTexte: The account, the payment methods accepted and any receipt will be given by the National Secretariat. Until they are, no payment button is shown: a gift you do not know how to receive is a gift you do not ask for.
soutenir.amisTitre: Become a Friend of the GBU.
soutenir.amisTexte: Were you part of the GBU? The movement is still yours. The Friends carry it over the long run — in prayer, financially, or by coming to speak about what they lived. It is a level of the movement in its own right, not a mailing list.
soutenir.amisAction: Join the Friends of the GBU
soutenir.ouVaTexte: The movement accounts for what it receives. Reports from the activities it supports — camps, meetings, training — are published under Movement life, with their photographs and their stories.
soutenir.troisTitre: Three ways, and not one more
soutenir.troisTexte: These are the three ways the movement actually practises. A fourth would be invented — and a page that invents a way of giving is a page that lies about what it does with the money.

nousEcrire.eyebrow: A question, a request, a proposal
nousEcrire.accroche: Your message goes to your city's committee, and to it alone. Someone will reply.
nousEcrire.nomIndice: First name, or first and last name
nousEcrire.messageIndice: Tell us in a few words what brings you here.
nousEcrire.devenirTitre: It goes to your city's committee, and to it alone.
nousEcrire.devenirTexte: It appears nowhere publicly. It is not passed on to the national level without your agreement. You can ask for it to be erased at any time, and it will be.
nousEcrire.devenirLien: What we do with your data
nousEcrire.chercheGroupeTexte: The “Join” path is quicker: three steps, no account, and the city committee replies to you directly.

rejoindre.display: Which city do you study in?
rejoindre.accroche: No account needed. Nobody will ask you for a password.
rejoindre.listeAttenteTexte: The other cities will be listed here, in the order the movement wants them named.
rejoindre.etape2Texte: Several cell groups meet there every week.
rejoindre.photoTexte: A campus in the city, or one of its places. With permission to publish.
rejoindre.cellulesNote: The city committee leader will tell you which cell group is nearest your campus, along with its meeting day and place. That information is not published on this site.
rejoindre.etape3Texte: The city committee will reply. Nobody else sees this message.
rejoindre.motIndice: I've just arrived and I don't know anyone.
rejoindre.viePriveeTexte: It goes to your city's committee, and to it alone. You can ask for it to be erased at any time.
rejoindre.autreCasEyebrow: Another case — no group in your city
rejoindre.autreCasTitre: No group where you are, yet.
rejoindre.autreCasTexte: But you are not at the end of the road. This case is treated with the same care as any other: it is where someone is lost, or caught.
rejoindre.option1Texte: Cell groups there welcome students who come from elsewhere.
rejoindre.option2Texte: Every student in Morocco meets there. You can come.
rejoindre.option3Texte: Every cell group began with one student who wrote in.
rejoindre.informeTexte: The day a cell group opens in your city, you will hear about it. That is the only thing we will use your address for.
